bounded_history.definition: Snapshots and SelfModel retain only the trailing N records of each diagnostic stream; older diagnostic samples are discarded. Authoritative ledger events (including body_schema_supersede) are never omitted by this bound.

action_prediction.justification: Recomputed each tick from active BodySchema + action params; trailing predictions retained in snapshot SelfModel.predictions (bound 256). Not required as ledger rows for birth resimulation.

prediction_error.justification: Full error stream lives in SelfModel.errors (snapshot-bounded). Birth resimulation recomputes errors from outcome_verified + body state. Ledger samples are observability only.

self_attribution.justification: Attributions recomputed during resimulation from body delta vs prediction without world truth; snapshot retains trailing attributions (bound 256).

body_change_evidence.justification: Accumulated in SelfModel.change_evidence (bound 64). Persistent change yields AUTHORITATIVE body_schema_supersede; isolated residuals do not rewrite the model.

body_model_supersession.justification: Every accepted schema rewrite is ledgered; required for provenance of active body-model lineage.

capability_degradation.justification: Part of accepted BodySchema state carried in snapshots and supersession lineage; not a sampled diagnostic stream.

capability_dormancy.justification: Same as capability_degradation — affordance state is authoritative body-model content.

reconstruction_contract.birth_replay: Identical seed + config + tick count resimulation reconstructs active body-model hash, supersession history, and capability affordances without reading prediction_error or self_attribution ledger rows.
reconstruction_contract.snapshot_replay: load_organism from latest snapshot restores SelfModel.to_state() including bounded diagnostic histories; must match live authoritative_state self_model hash.
reconstruction_contract.snapshots_do_not_conceal_missing_authori: Deleting body_schema_supersede (or any authoritative event) breaks the hash chain (validate_chain fail-closed). Snapshot state_hash mismatch on self_model fails closed on load.
